subject: Proposed co-hosted webinar with MarTechCo — scheduling, ops & MDF
messages:
From: Sage Turner <sage.turner@martechco.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: events@martechco.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Opportunity — joint webinar + co-marketing for Oct

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well. We’re lining up an October webinar series focused on practical strategies for integrating open models into product stacks and thought Redwood would be an excellent co-host. High-level ask: a 45-minute panel + live demo (30 min + 15 min Q&A), joint promotion to both audiences, and shared sponsorship costs / MDF for promotional spend.

Questions from our side:
- Do you have availability the week of Oct 6 or the week of Oct 13?
- What MDF cadence/thresholds does Redwood typically work with for partner webinars?
- Any preference on panel format (product demo + customer case vs. fireside + walkthrough)?

We typically cover 50% of ad spend for co-hosted webinars and can support an email send to ~60k. If this is interesting, happy to jump on a quick 20-min sync to align.

Thanks,
Sage Turner
Partnerships Lead, MarTechCo

Attachments: none
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sage Turner <sage.turner@martechco.com>
Cc: alex_martinez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity — joint webinar + co-marketing for Oct

Hi Sage 9

Thanks for the note 99we’d love to co-host. High level: Redwood is available both weeks (Oct 6 and Oct 13) but we prefer earlier in the month to avoid holiday schedules. Our usual MDF band for partner webinars is $8k$18k depending on expected reach and paid channels. Typical split looks like: 50/50 promo spend, Redwood provides content + host moderation, partner provides customer intro.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you share a one-page SOW with audience targets and proposed promo plan?
- We’ll run this through our Field Events calendar and get an MDF estimate.
- Quick sync Friday (11:30am PT) to lock date/format? I’ll mark a tentative slot.

I’m attaching our co-host checklist so we can both fill responsibilities and timelines.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments:
- CoHost_Checklist.xlsx (1 worksheet)
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Opportunity — joint webinar + co-marketing for Oct

Vanessa / Karthik,

Looping in thoughts on MDF and ops before we commit:
- MDF: If MarTechCo can guarantee a minimum registrant target (2k+), I’d be comfortable with approving up to $15k of matched promo. Otherwise we should aim for $10k.
- Paid channels: Recommend we reserve ~$6k for targeted LinkedIn + programmatic retargeting, rest for creative and email amplification.
- Speaker lineup: Need one customer + 1 product engineer from Redwood. Kar please confirm availability for Oct 9 (preferred) or Oct 14 alternate.
- Booth/Conf tie-in: If they push us to do a hybrid with a smaller shared booth, we should cap booth staff to 2 people and request booth-cost share in the SOW.

I attached a quick budget sketch. If everyone agrees, I can draft the approval note for finance.

-Alex
Alex Martinez
Director of Sales | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com

Attachments:
- Budget_Sept_Q4.xlsx
